observations: No gem in this stage, yet 87 boxes and a hidden green !: the crates are built for their second life in Future Tense, whose printed checkpoints count them pass by pass.
Crates price the timing hazard: each cluster sits where a stop already happens (before/after a beam fence, on a stationary pad), so the all-box run roughly doubles the fence encounters.
Crates over moving belts need a lead; the belt-edge crate is bait because the belt keeps pushing toward the drop.
Explosive escalation: TNT lid (S1-e) -> Nitro corner in a 2x2 (S1-f) -> Nitro ring (S1-h) -> Nitro foundation (S4-a).
TNT as tool, wall and weapon: it kills a robot (S3-b) and forms a wall a spring clears (S3-f).
Side-scroll hiding is vertical: five clusters and the green ! sit below platform lips.
One big reinforced deposit (8 of S1's 25 boxes) gives a slow beat after the belt-and-fence rush.
Time trial converts two crates into masks so a flawless run is invincible through the three-fence belt.
Density: S1 25+4N in 9 clusters, S2 10, S3 20 + bonus 19, S4 8+1N.
Checkpoints follow camera changes and the stage-29 merge point.
